rationale: Comments are `stream`-level siblings of `document`, so the walk reaches them BEFORE the key they document and a pending-comment buffer cannot see them. They are indexed by the line they precede, with their column, and attached positionally. Pinned: a leading note, a second leading note, a note at the top of a nested block, and a TRAILING note on the key's own row -- the last is what a single-line scan would lose.

expectDocstring.contains: a leading note at the top of a nested block
